headline: Maharashtra unveils Global Workforce Mobility Policy 2026 to prepare skilled talent for overseas jobs
summary: The Maharashtra government has launched the Global Workforce Mobility Policy 2026 to prepare the state's workforce for international job opportunities. The initiative features country-specific "Skill Passports," language courses, and updated institute curricula to align local training with global labor shortages. Additionally, the policy aims to establish secure recruitment mechanisms and facilitate the re-integration of returning workers into local industries.

headline: Jatin Suley joins Varroc as cluster head HR
summary: Varroc has appointed Jatin Suley as its new Cluster Head HR, bringing over 28 years of human resources experience across the automotive, engineering, and manufacturing sectors. Suley previously held senior HR roles at prominent organizations including Bosch India, TM Automotive Seating Systems, Lucas TVS, and KEC International. His expertise spans plant HR, workforce management, and employee and labor relations.

headline: HR Perspectives by Dr IVS Ranganath: “My mandate is not to replace Tropolite’s legacy. It is to build on it”
summary: Dr. IVS Ranganath is leading the strategic HR transformation at Tropolite Foods as it transitions from a promoter-led business into a professionally managed enterprise. Rather than discarding legacy processes, Ranganath focuses on preserving the company's entrepreneurial spirit while building structured governance, modern leadership practices, and clearer organizational communication. His approach emphasizes creating a unified corporate purpose tailored to distinct employee roles to drive scalable future growth.

headline: Postal employees seek early announcement of 2025-26 PLB
summary: The All India Postal Employees Union Group 'C' has requested that the Department of Posts declare the 2025-26 Productivity Linked Bonus well ahead of the upcoming festive season. Union leadership noted that past announcement delays disrupted staff's financial planning for major events such as Durga Puja, Dussehra, and Diwali. An early disbursement schedule would allow postal workers to better manage their festival-related expenses and family obligations.
